notes.title: BlastBall: All-Stars at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Up to 4 friends can play Air Hockey, Soccer, Dodgeball, and Tennis in this free demo of BlastBall: All-Stars! 

No friends around right now? No problem! Just load up a few bots and jump into practice, quickplay, or set up a tournament as you get a taste of the action.

With simple, intuitive controls, hopping into any sport is easy. Utilize your blast charges and add spin to your shots to become a real All-Star!

Check out the BlastBall: All-Stars demo and wishlist now!
Have feedback for us? Join our Discord!

The full version of BlastBall: All-Stars is expected to be released in Q1 of 2025. 
Featuring: 

Soccer
Air Hockey
Gagaball
Royalty
Dodgeball
Knockout
Volleyball
Tennis
Squash
Pickleball

There are even more sports, game modes (and secrets) to come. Follow along and have yourself a BLAST!
